jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Office of the CEO
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity

Join the Office of the CEO and work directly on Flexport's highest-priority problems alongside the CEO, the President, and the leaders who run our regions and modes of freight. You will pick up a mode or a region, ocean, air, trucking, omnichannel, or customs, and learn it from the inside by solving real problems in it. Pricing in a mode that is losing money. Why a region misses its plan. Whether we buy, build, or partner.

Then you go run part of it. Some people in this role move into a business unit as the number two to the leader who runs it. Some stay at the center and take on more scope. The operating job at the end is the point of the role, not a side benefit.

You will:

- Own our biggest open questions end to end and come back with recommendations the CEO can act on.

- Build the analysis yourself. Pull the data, build the model, find the error before someone else does.

- Go to where the work happens, from warehouses and ports to a customer's supply chain team. Opinions about freight formed in a conference room are usually wrong.

- Run the operating cadence for a freight mode or region. Weekly metrics, quarterly plan, and the follow-ups nobody wants to chase.

- Get things unstuck, which often means finding the four people who need to agree and getting them in a room.

- Use AI on everything and automate your own job as you learn it.

You should have:

- 4 to 6 years in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, a high-growth operating role, or running your own company. Founders who shut it down are welcome. Tell us what broke.

- The ability to build a financial model from a blank sheet and defend every cell.

- A track record of taking an ambiguous problem, doing the research, and turning it into a recommendation a senior leader can act on.

- Relentless curiosity about how physical goods move. Freight is messy, old, and full of edge cases. That should sound interesting to you, not tedious.

- Clear, short writing and the judgment to influence people more senior than you.

- A compliance first attitude. We operate in a heavily regulated industry and our regulators matter to us.

This is not for you if:

- You want to stay in strategy. Every one of these seats is a path into an operating job.

- You need a fixed scope. The scope changes when the business changes.

- You want to work remotely. You need to be in the room.

You will get:

- Direct exposure to the CEO and the executive team from week one.

- A real operating job at the end of it, not a vague promise.

- The fastest way we know to learn how global trade actually works.

jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking highly motivated individuals for a full-time position as an Operations Manager in one of our fulfillment centers. As a key member of the Flexport team, you will take on a leadership role responsible for managing operations and a team on the operating floor. This position offers a unique opportunity to invest in others, cultivate a collaborative leadership style, and contribute to shaping the future of logistics. We are looking for candidates who are eager to take on this challenge, be part of our dynamic and innovative organization, and make a lasting impact on the industry.

Location: Phillipsburg, NJ

You Will

- Lead, coach, manage, and develop a team of 200+ associates and 4+ salaried managers, ensuring their productivity, engagement, and professional growth.

- Communicate and enforce policies and procedures, serving as the primary source of information for the team, while ensuring compliance, consistency, and taking corrective action when necessary.

- Create, manage, and support recognition programs to foster a positive work culture and boost employee morale.

- Implement and maintain safety programs, ensuring compliance with OSHA regulations to provide a safe work environment for all associates.

- Establish and enforce procedures for building security and product loss prevention, mitigating risks and minimizing inventory shrinkage.

- Serve as a key member of the Operations team, holding the position of Operations Manager in one of our largest fulfillment centers nationwide.

- Own and report on performance metrics within the fulfillment center, including on-time receiving and shipping, inventory accuracy, and packing quality.

- Set and uphold strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) expectations for yourself and your team, delivering clear verbal and written reports on performance and developing action plans as needed.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve fulfillment-related issues, ensuring smooth operations and customer satisfaction.

- Act as the escalation point for risk mitigation and issue resolution, providing timely and effective solutions.

- Identify gaps in inventory accuracy, analyze root causes, and drive strategic initiatives to improve processes and achieve higher accuracy levels.

- Analyze defect rates, identify trends, and recommend operational improvements internally and across the network to enhance efficiency and reduce errors.

- Contribute to the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) by documenting best practices and lessons learned, ensuring standardized and optimized processes.

- Work closely with the Growth and Engineering teams, prioritizing the resolution of systemic problems and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

- Own CPU and cost metrics.

You Should Have

- A minimum of 4 years of experience managing a team of 4 or more salaried individuals.

- Physical capability to lift up to 49 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

- Willingness and ability to frequently engage in physically demanding tasks such as pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching.

- Ability to stand/walk for extended periods, typically up to 10-12 hours.

- Comfort working in an environment with varying noise levels

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Americas Control Tower
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

The Manager, Americas Control Tower leads the execution strategy for ocean and air freight operations across North and Latin America, based out of Flexport’s Guadalajara office. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence through consistent process execution, quality management, and standardization across regions, panning Ocean (FCL/LCL) and Air, and Flexport’s growing Control Tower product suite. The Operations Manager oversees the daily performance of their team’s workflows, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to service standards. A key focus of this role is developing scalable, repeatable processes that enhance efficiency and consistency across pre-departure tasks, while also overseeing select post-arrival functions owned by the Control Tower. This position works closely with regional Gateway, Carrier Performance Management, and Demand teams to identify performance gaps, implement best practices, and align stakeholders around a shared goal: delivering a seamless, best-in-class experience for our clients.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Control Tower Development

- Build, lead, and develop a team of Gateway Operators within the Americas Control Tower, able to execute across both ocean and air modes

- Serve as the primary leadership presence for the Americas Control Tower from day one; act as the bridge between Control Tower operators and regional Gateway leadership teams

- Establish clear escalation protocols, communication rhythms, and performance standards between the Control Tower and its regional counterparts

- Lead weekend and after-hours coverage planning for accounts requiring extended support

Operational Performance

- Oversee exception management workflows: dwelling cargo, document discrepancies, milestone gaps, line holds, and carrier SLA resolution

- Ensure flexibility is maintained across ocean and air modes; gateway operators flex between modes based on volume and account needs

- Act as a client-facing escalation point for high-priority issues, partnering with Account Management and Demand to ensure client expectations are met and communicated clearly

- Partner with Americas ops leaders on outbound forecasting, terminal dwell, milestone accuracy, and timely carrier communication

Process, Standards & Scalability

- Develop and maintain SOPs for all Control Tower-managed functions; ensure consistent, repeatable, and compliant execution across modes and accounts

- Generate SLAs for the Control Tower team aligned with regional and company-wide goals

Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting

- Develop dashboards and reporting to measure team performance; support regional leadership in data-driven decisions on carrier strategy and account management

- Collaborate with Carrier Performance Management and Demand teams to surface insights from Control Tower-managed shipments

- Partner with product leaders to develop product strategy that supports Control Tower execution needs

Hiring & Team Growth

- Plan for headcount, hire, grow, and manage a high-performing team as scope expands

- Identify and develop team leads from within the operator cohort as the Control Tower matures

Experience Needed:

- BA/BS degree and/or 5+ years of experience in relevant freight forwarding, transportation, or supply chain roles

- 3+ years of people management experience in a relevant freight forwarding, transportation, or supply chain role required

- English and Spanish language fluency required, as the role requires professional-level Spanish for team leadership and shipper/carrier coordination

- In-depth knowledge of freight forwarding technology and platforms; experience partnering with product teams to deliver operational improvements

- Analytical, metrics-driven approach to problem solving; strong working knowledge of analytical tools (Looker, BI dashboards, AI, Google Suite/Microsoft Suite, etc.)

- Experience developing and enforcing SOPs in a high-volume operational environment

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, including the confidence to represent Flexport directly to clients and carriers; ability to manage effectively across time zones and cultural contexts

Preferred Qualifications:

- Portuguese language proficiency

- Ability and willingness to travel to the US as needed

Worried about not having any freight forwarding experience?

- Don’t be! We’re building the first Operating System for Global Trade. That’s why it’s incredibly important for us to bring people from diverse backgrounds and experiences together with our industry veterans to help move the freight forwarding industry forward.

- What’s freight forwarding and why does it matter? Listen to Ryan, our CEO explain what freight forwarding is and why improving global trade can help to connect the world and break down economic barriers in this Fast Company Freethink Original Series video.

- We know this industry is complex. That’s why we invest in education starting day one with Flexport Academy, a one week intensive onboarding program designed specifically to set every new Flexport employee up for success.

About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make it easy and accessible for everyone. We’re shaping the future of a $8.6T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. At a valuation of $8 billion, we’re experiencing record growth and are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions, and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

The role of the Senior Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. In this role, you will work with different internal and external team stakeholders, such as internal ocean gateway operations teams, account management and customs teams, and other functions to continuously identify areas to improve, drive alignment, and lead implementations. You will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport, allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone. This role is designed to build your leadership capabilities and communication & project management skills within a global operations team.

As a senior operations associate focusing on product, you are expected to utilize knowledge of the end-to-end shipment operations process and be equipped with a process-driven, data-driven, and continuous improvement mindset to deliver results in one or multiple areas:

Responsibilities:

- When there are associates or specialists in your team, you will be responsible for supervising, coaching, and monitoring their performance.

- You will use metrics to guide your team to improve and deliver great performance and enhance their hard skills and soft skills.

- You will personally represent Flexport’s value proposition by leading and driving the progress of tasks and projects in your scope to contribute to operational excellence.

- Your detailed scope and responsibilities will include:

Product Improvement:

- You will work closely with internal teams in APAC Ocean Gateway Operations to have an effective process to collaborate with the Tech team.

- You can understand how the latest processes and products interact with each other and the background behind them in order to represent or facilitate the operations team in talking to the Tech team.

- You can think and communicate structurally to explain the operations process, product needs, and impact, or put together a BRD (Business Request Document) or ticket to help the Tech team understand.

- You have the team and company goals in mind and shepherd the business team to properly prioritize the product requests when facing resource constraints.

- You are able to maintain a good relationship with different relevant Tech teams and properly push the Tech team to provide resource commitment and drive product feature delivery. Know who to escalate to when it is required.

- You are sensitive and creative enough to capture opportunities to productize an operations process and initiate product improvement projects.

- You are able to work with people at different levels and different teams. You can pull people from different teams to work toward a common goal.

- You can effectively provide updates to stakeholders on key issues that may impact project completion, budget, or other results

Process Optimization:

- You will work closely with internal teams in the APAC Ocean team to cultivate a continuous process improvement mindset and support the team in identifying areas to improve with data.

- You can understand the background behind an existing process and support the operations team to find solutions to optimize the process to drive down costs to serve and increase operational efficiency.

- You can initiate a process improvement project when you see there are opportunities and drive project development to successfully implement the change.

- You can represent or facilitate the APAC Ocean Gateway Operations team to discuss, negotiate, or align on a process design and implementation, but also can think of the overall gains.

- You can be open to listening to different parties’ input and think from an execution perspective, but also consider the company’s benefits as a whole to design an actionable and effective process.

- You can develop metrics to measure the success of a process change and establish the mechanism to monitor the trend post-launch.

- You are able to work with people at different levels and different teams. You can pull people from different teams to work toward a common goal.

- You can effectively provide updates to stakeholders on key issues that may impact project completion, budget, or other results.

What you will need:

Experience:

- BA/BS degree

- Minimum 3-5 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting

- Excellent command of both spoken and written English and Chinese/Mandarin.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Proven ability to build strong, cohesive relationships with the business, operations, technology, and other key stakeholders

- Data-driven, strong analytical and logical sense

- Strong attention to detail and proficient problem-solving skills.

- Strong sense of prioritization and ability to execute deliverables

Mindset :

We’re looking for folks who have:

- Desire to “build a better machine” and get irritated when things aren’t optimal

- Demonstrated ability to lead small teams in day-to-day execution

- Hands-on, process-oriented, structured thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities

- Strategic vision and ground-floor execution

- Excitement to exercise your leadership skills to pull people together

- Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it!

- Flexibility to get the job done when needed. Willing to work outside office hours and occasional weekend or night shifts in certain locations.

Skills:

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

- Good command of both spoken and written English and Chinese/Mandarin

- Optimizing processes analytically

- Building feedback loops for a product or project

- Problem-Solving 4: Building consensus among people with strongly differing opinions

- Managing time and commitments

- Generating ideas through data

- Forming hypotheses and developing experiments

- Framing problems

- Investigating and troubleshooting operations problems

- Solving problems through hypothesis-based root cause analysis

Growth and development:

Skills you can advance in this role:

- All of the above +

- Coaching your colleagues

- Encouraging your team to improve how the team works

- Helping your team learn from performance outcomes

- Inspiring your team

- Organizing, leading, and participating in meetings

- Project delivery ability

- Cross-team communication skills

- Process and metrics design skills

What you will learn:

- You will gain the skills necessary to lead a team of increasing scale and function. You will learn how to be a player-coach who apprentices team members in skill development.

- You will learn what it takes to effectively drive people from different teams but not directly report to you: holding them accountable while also creating win-win opportunities.

- You will learn how to thrive in an ambiguous environment, research and implement hypotheses, and inform the strategy of a newly built team.

- You will learn how to facilitate discussion, decision-making, and conflict resolution.

jobs.description:
About Flexport:

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Operations Manager to oversee the operations of our fulfillment center in Philipsburg, New Jersey. As the Sr. Operations Manager, you will be responsible for managing a team of 300+ associates and ensuring efficient and effective functioning of the facility. Your exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, and operational expertise will be crucial in driving the success of our fulfillment center. This role will require expertise in managing both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) fulfillment operations, with a hands-on approach to driving efficiency, cost reduction, and customer satisfaction. Join us to build and develop a world-class fulfillment center and contribute to the continued growth of Flexport.

You will:

- Leadership and Team Management:

- Provide strong leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the entire team, fostering a positive and productive work environment.

- Manage and develop a high-performing team of 300+ associates, including hiring, training, coaching, and performance management.

- Lead a team of 10 salaried employees, including department managers and supervisors, ensuring their success and alignment with organizational goals

- Operational Excellence:

- Oversee the day-to-day operations of the fulfillment center, ensuring efficient and accurate processing of orders, inventory management, and shipping for both D2C and B2B customers.

- Develop and implement operational strategies to optimize productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction.

- Establish operational distinctions for D2C vs. B2B fulfillment, ensuring proper flow paths, picking methodologies, and shipping requirements are met.

- Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to drive continuous improvement and achieve operational targets.

- Foster a culture of safety, ensuring compliance with all applicable health and safety regulations and implementing measures to minimize workplace accidents and injuries.

- Budgeting and Cost Management:

- Develop and manage the fulfillment center's budget, ensuring financial objectives are met while maintaining operational excellence.

- Identify opportunities to optimize costs, reduce waste, and improve overall operational efficiency without compromising quality or service levels.

- Implement cost control measures and monitor expenses, ensuring adherence to budgetary guidelines.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:

- Collaborate with other departments such as logistics, procurement, customer service, and quality control to ensure seamless coordination and integration of processes.

- Partner with the Regional General Manager to align fulfillment center strategies with overall company goals and objectives.

- Provide regular reports, updates, and insights to senior management on operational performance, challenges, and opportunities.

- Continuous Improvement and Innovation:

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, and technology advancements.

- Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies related to fulfillment center operations, and implement relevant changes as appropriate.

You should have:

- Bachelor's degree in business administration, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).

- Proven experience as a Site Leader or similar leadership role, preferably in a large-scale fulfillment center or distribution environment.

- Strong knowledge of fulfillment center operations, including order processing, inventory management, warehousing, and shipping.

- Demonstrated success in managing and developing large teams of both hourly and salaried employees.

- Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve goals.

- Proficiency in analyzing data, metrics, and KPIs to drive performance improvements.

- Solid financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost management, and driving operational efficiency.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining attention to detail and ensuring accuracy.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with a strategic mindset.
